analysis.insight_summary: Users need assistance with hardware substitution due to discontinued modules. Main concerns include compatibility between new and legacy components, program migration to newer modules, and ensuring the updated solution is future-proof. Obstacles involve product replacement rules, compatible expansion options, and updating software projects. Users value clear upgrade guidelines but face compatibility and required updates in engineering tools.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to swap discontinued modules with new ones, continue using their expansion modules, and transfer existing programs seamlessly, preferably without major adjustments.
